title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-02-14

ai_review.summary: Legendary soundboard recording of a top‑10 Grateful Dead performance, highlighted by an all‑time great second set and the masterful “Alligator”.
ai_review.review: Reviewers hail this show as one of the band’s finest – the first set is called excellent and the second set is described as “one of the greatest of all time”, even serving as source material for *Anthem of the Sun*.  The recording, a soundboard (sbd) capture, is praised as legendary with no reported flaws, making it both musically and technically outstanding.

ai_rating.rationale: A detailed five‑star review lauds both the performance (top‑10 level) and implies excellent soundboard quality; lack of negative feedback yields a near‑perfect combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a “legendary recording”; no specific issues mentioned, indicating clear and crisp sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set called excellent; second set hailed as one of the greatest ever, delivering a powerful, seamless flow that stands out in Dead history.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry’s guitar work is praised as “wow fucking cool” with his iconic stage look noted by the reviewer.
